notes.title: Rollin' Garry Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Rollin' Garry has been released! Hope you all enjoy it!

[i]Thank you for your continued support![/i]

notes.title: Rollin' Garry Release Date Announced!
notes.content: [p]I'm proud to announce that Rollin' Garry is scheduled to be released on [b]September 18th, 2025[/b] at approx 2 PM GMT.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to having you all play it and as always thank you for your continued support![/p]

notes.title: Rollin' Garry Developer Log #1
notes.content: [p][i]I'm really bad at writing these so I'll keep it brief![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Progress made so far:[/b][/p][p][b]-  Made significant progress on the core level. The main thing left to do is just more testing and adjustments, but the base layout is done. [/b][/p][p][b] - Added one of the bonus gamemodes. [/b][/p][p][b]- Added/reworked UI elements.[/b][/p][p][b]- Fixed various bugs with the general gameplay mechanics.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]To everyone out there that has supported this project so far, thank you! Your support is greatly appreciated![/b][/p]
